name: Camping Lindlbauer
beschreibung: Camping Lindlbauer is located in the village of Inzell in Tirol. The site is surrounded by meadows and forests. It has numerous pitches for motorhomes and tents. The sanitary facilities are clean and well maintained. A playground and a lounge are available. The surrounding area is suitable for hiking and cycling tours. In winter, cross-country ski trails and ski areas are nearby. The site is also suitable for longer stays.
